alex (Docs): Hey team — I'm opening a docs PR for the Console observability section. It adds a 'trace -> dashboard' quickstart that auto-filters dashboards using trace IDs. Need a Node + Go SDK snippet and a small migration note for dashboards v2 -> v3 widget. PTAL. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/412
maya (Product): love it. can you include cost/latency example and a note about SLO impact?
sam (Eng Runtime): I can add the Node snippet. Which SDK version should we reference? latest v0.9 or v1.x?
alex (Docs): prefer v1.0, but include a v0.9 fallback. keep snippet <=20 lines.
leo (ML): for trace header let's standardize on `x-redwood-trace-id`. the dashboard filter expects `trace_id` param. add a tiny helper: `getTraceId(req.headers['x-redwood-trace-id'])`
maya (Product): also add guidance for canary: "enable for 10% traffic for 24h" and a short regression checklist.
sam (Eng Runtime): here's a quick Node snippet I'll paste into PR:
```js
const {redwood} = require('@redwood/inference');
redwood.emitTrace({traceId: req.headers['x-redwood-trace-id']});
```
will add Go shortly.
leo (ML): Go version:
```go
client.EmitTrace(context.Background(), headers.Get("x-redwood-trace-id"))
```
alex (Docs): ✅ thanks. two asks: 1) can someone run the docs linter before merging? 2) we need an internal link to the dashboard template (docs:/dashboards/templates/trace-filter)
docs-linter-bot: lint error in docs/observability/trace-to-dashboard.md: line 78 - missing backticks around `trace_id`
deploy-bot: CI for PR 412 — build ok, spellcheck failed (1 warning)
alex (Docs): I'll fix the backticks and add a note in the migration section about the v3 widget param rename `traceKey` -> `trace_id`.
maya (Product): small UX ask — show a screenshot of the dashboard filter dropdown populated by the incoming trace id.
sam (Eng Runtime): added a tiny helper in PR that sets header from middleware. pushing in 5.
leo (ML): quick question — should we also recommend prefix caching for KV cache on tracing-heavy flows? reduces cost spikes.
maya (Product): yes include recommendation and an example config snippet for cache TTL 30s.
alex (Docs): thanks all — I'll update PR, run linter locally, and request reviews from @maya and @sam. target merge window: tomorrow 10am PT.
maya (Product): ack. I'll review after lunch.
sam (Eng Runtime): will check SDK snippets and CI once pushed.
alex (Docs): done — linter pass locally, pushed fixes. pinging reviewers.
maya (Product): reviewed, minor wording nit, approved.
sam (Eng Runtime): approved, Go snippet formatting fixed.
deploy-bot: PR 412 merged at 1745123498 :rocket: 
alex (Docs): merged. follow-up: schedule a short blurb in release notes about dashboard filter param rename.
